java-to-db2-migration-assistant.name: Java to DB2 Migration Assistant
java-to-db2-migration-assistant.description: AI-powered assistant for migrating Java applications from PostgreSQL to IBM DB2. Provides schema conversion, query translation, configuration generation, and test suite creation.

tools.name: convertPostgresSchemaToDb2
tools.description: Convert PostgreSQL database schema (CREATE TABLE statements) to DB2-compatible DDL with Flyway migration script. Handles data type conversions (SERIAL→IDENTITY, TEXT→CLOB, BOOLEAN→SMALLINT), timestamp functions, and index syntax.

schemaSQL.description: PostgreSQL CREATE TABLE statements or full schema DDL

tools.name: convertPostgresQueryToDb2
tools.description: Convert PostgreSQL SQL queries or JPA/Spring Data code to DB2-compatible syntax. Handles string operations (||→CONCAT), case-insensitive search (ILIKE→LIKE), boolean logic (TRUE/FALSE→1/0), pagination (LIMIT/OFFSET→FETCH FIRST), and date/time functions.

jpaOrSql.description: PostgreSQL SQL query, JPA query, or Spring Data repository method

tools.name: generateDb2ConnectionConfig
tools.description: Generate complete DB2 connection configuration for Quarkus/Spring Boot from IBM Cloud credentials. Creates application.properties with JDBC URL, Hibernate dialect, Flyway setup, and connection pool settings. Also provides Maven dependencies.

tools.name: generateMigrationTestSuite
tools.description: Generate comprehensive JUnit 5 test suite for validating PostgreSQL to DB2 migration. Creates tests for entity persistence (IDENTITY, CLOB, boolean 0/1), repository queries (FETCH FIRST pagination, LIKE search), service transactions, and DB2-specific features.

originalCode.description: Original Java code (Entity, Repository, or Service) to generate tests for
